title: The Quiet Extraction
author: Ansel Crane
blurb: Elodie Thackeray, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
